description: Returns the current time in UTC and a specified or guessed timezone.

format.description: The format for the returned time string. Either a dayjs token string (e.g. "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss") or a named format: "iso8601" / "rfc3339" (ISO 8601 UTC), "unix" (epoch seconds), "unix_ms" (epoch milliseconds).

timezone.description: The IANA timezone name (e.g., "America/New_York"). Defaults to the server's guessed timezone.

name: current_time
title: Get Current Time
